ratings_why.fun: One dial that splits into Simmer and Boil Over is a real draft fork, but turns 1-4 are thin and Simmer becomes solved arithmetic once assembled.
ratings_why.distinct: A press-your-luck Lamp with a movable Flashpoint and in-fight Flares plays unlike any of today's tribes, though 'spells make it grow' echoes a familiar spell tribe.

verdict_why: The core is sound, but a few timing rules (The Herald at Start of Turn, The Old Lady in a fight) don't work as written yet.

points.text: Heat resets at Start of Turn and The Herald Stokes at Start of Turn; the order isn't stated, so The Herald could do nothing. Say the reset comes first.
The Old Lady says once a turn, but Flares also happen in fights. Say whether she can catch a fight Flare, since Lamp in the Fight depends on it.
Pestle Noctuid's 'another random unit next to this' could mean other than the target or other than the Noctuid. Name which.
Turns 1-4 have almost no Heat payoff. A Tier 1 or 2 piece that pays at low Heat (for example at 3 or more) would let the dial matter from the first shop.
The Spectacle is the tribe's mid-game climb. A second Tier 4 or 5 card that pays at exactly the Flashpoint would make Simmer a build you find, not a single card you need.

standouts.why: The Alchymist moves the Flashpoint to 3 and changes how both builds play: a real capstone that bends the tribe's rule.
The Spectacle makes landing exactly on 7 a satisfying target every turn, with a clear double payout.
Mother Shipton turns end-of-turn Heat into a Start of Combat hit and ties the recruit puzzle to the fight.

weakest.why: Six-spot Burnet has little Heat to read early and only small Bristle later; it is mostly a 2/2.
Eyed Hawk-moth's Attack drain is small until Heat is high, and it overlaps with Burnet's front-row job.
Skep Pilferer is plain once-a-turn gold with no link to Heat or Flares.

flags.note: Old Carbonaria counts all Heat gained, so Flashpoint doesn't cap her; with Lamp-Fanner, Burnished Brass and Dame Pavonia she can pay well over the Tier 6 top end.
Lamplit Compounder with Burnished Brass and a golden copy pays per cast at high Heat; bounded by Phial supply, but worth the owner's eye.
Start of Turn order against the Heat reset isn't stated.
'Once a turn' doesn't say if it works on a Flare in a fight.
